title: Bound independent URL policy fixture groups by their Git launch workload
outcome: Bound independent URL policy fixture groups by their Git launch workload
acceptance: Each independent URL-policy fixture group has an explicit bounded launch workload separated from the product execution deadline, preserving every malformed-URL, encoded-URL, helper and TLS assertion.

The correction reduces cumulative unrelated case work within a single supervising deadline without increasing product deadlines, skipping assertions or retrying until green; owned Windows checks pass and report the fixture grouping/bounds.

completion.summary: Split the URL-policy fixture into independent bounded launch workloads of 30, 30, 16 and 42 calls, with one owned supervisor each. Exact launch/case counts preserve all 14 malformed URLs plus encoded, fabricated sentinel, credential-helper, TLS, redirect and redaction assertions. Product deadlines remain 30 seconds; no production code or retry changed. Full round3 gate passed all12 stages on exact reviewed freeze, Codex/Claude whole-input pair has no actionable findings, and independent acceptance passed2/2.
